messages:
support: FYI — Apex Corp reporting repeated invoice charge failures for PO autopay in EU. They enabled PO/auto-bill on their account and several invoices at end-of-month are failing. Symptoms: immediate decline with gateway codes like `authentication_required` or `do_not_honor`. Autopay is server-to-server so no browser redirect is possible.

Attached snippet from gateway: `{\n  \"status\": \"declined\",\n  \"reason\": \"3ds_required\",\n  \"acquirer_code\": \"05_do_not_honor\"\n}`

Any quick triage tips? Customer needs an unblock within the day.

leo: @support can you paste the raw gateway response headers + acquirer name and BIN? :eyes: Also which merchant account (apex-prod / apex-eu)?

billing: Do we have the customer's VAT/tax id on file? Some EU acquirers bump fraud score if VAT metadata is missing. Also confirm merchant account used.

tia: Noted — we pushed a routing policy change yesterday that disables interactive 3DS fallback for autopay flows to prevent UX loops. If the acquirer insists on 3DS, autopay currently fails fast. Could be the cause.

eng-oncall: Can you share a reproducible txn id and the request payload? I’ll pull runtime routing logs to see if we attempted a challenge or fallback. Please include `redwood-runtime` trace id.

support: Sample tx: tx_43b7c9 (attached). Request payload:
```
POST /v1/payments
{ "amount": 12500, "currency": "EUR", "payment_method": "card_abc", "metadata": { "po_id": "PO-9876", "merchant_account": "apex-eu" } }
```
Runtime trace: trace-7721
Gateway reply (truncated): `{"status":"declined","code":"3ds_required","acquirer":"bankcorp","acquirer_code":"05"}`

anita: Temporary workarounds — two options: 1) enable `autopay_allow_interactive_3ds=true` on the customer so we can route to an interactive challenge (email flow) for this merchant, or 2) route apex-eu to an alternate acquirer/fallback if permitted. Also increase retry window for `do_not_honor` to catch transient insufficient-funds cases. Repro curl to simulate: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/payments -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -H 'X-Trace: trace-7721' -d '{"amount":12500,"currency":"EUR","payment_method":"card_abc","metadata":{"po_id":"PO-9876","merchant_account":"apex-eu"}}'
```

deploy-bot: Rolling back routing change on staging to test. Deployment r-2026 started 10:42 UTC :rotating_light:

leo: If acquirer is enforcing fraud rules, merchant may need to work with acquirer to whitelist BINs or pass additional KYC/VAT metadata. Also note some acquirers return `do_not_honor` for both fraud and insufficient_funds — need full acquirer response to disambiguate.

billing: Apex just provided VAT ID — I’ve added it to their account and queued a manual retry. I also asked them to add a backup payment method (bank transfer) as a fallback.

eng-oncall: I’m enabling a short canary override to allow interactive 3DS for `apex-eu` for the next 2 hours and will re-run tx_43b7c9. If that succeeds we should revert the strict autopay policy or whitelist this merchant. Creating incident now.

support: Customer asked for ETA — can we target 2 hours? :pray:

eng-oncall: On it. Created INC-2026-77 — will update here when test completes.

eng-oncall: UPDATE (2h): Ran the same card with interactive 3DS enabled; authorization succeeded (auth code 00). Looks like acquirer required challenge. Interim workaround: allow interactive 3DS for Apex or use alternate acquirer. Billing to coordinate longer-term fix (whitelist / acquirer KYC). Closing interim escalation — follow-up ticket created for routing policy rollback review. :thumbsup:
